public_anchor.text: Review all invoices from last quarter and verify correct rate based on customer state.
Flag any discrepancies and email the compliance report to tax@company.example.com.
Verify correct tax rate per customer state; California rate increased to 7.5% effective Dec 1, 2025.

obligations.mechanism_sketch: The report checks cover the known OR discrepancy and CA post-Dec rate only. They do not compute tax as a function of invoice subtotal, customer state, applicable effective date and rate for every quarter invoice.
